newsitem.title: USA: Little Gym IPO delayed indefinitely - underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Little Gym IPO delayed indefinitely - underwriter.

text.p: Little Gym International Inc's proposed initial public offering has been delayed indefinitely, according to a spokesman for the company's underwriter.
National Securities Corp spokesman Paul Behmer said the deal had been slated for early September but was now delayed. He gave no details on whether the offering would resurface later.
The company initially planned an offering of 625,000 units, each unit consisting of three shares and two warrants, at a maximum estimated price of $16, he said.
Little Gym had proposed to trade its common shares under the symbol "LGYM" on the Nasdaq.
Little Gym, based in Scottsdale, Arizona, is a recreational gymnastic program geared towards the physical development of children.
